title: Repair shop asks for a website
brief:
Client: Brass Finch Cycles; contact robin@example.com.
Develop two logo concepts and refine one selected concept.
Design one double-sided business card using the approved logo.
Supply SVG and PNG logo files and a print PDF of the card.
Two revision rounds apply to the selected logo and card layout.
Concepts are due 21 October; approved artwork is due 31 October.
Out of scope: websites, hosting, copywriting and social assets.
message: The logo and cards are all we need for print. Please build a five-page website with a repair booking form as well. We will provide the wording.

expected_items.anchor: build a five-page website with a repair booking form
expected_items.label: extra_work
expected_items.rationale: A website and booking feature are outside the logo-and-card deliverables and explicitly excluded.
